summary: Backend-only review of DO RDP/VPS AMD-only hardening. Ran all 10 requested node suites serially from /app/js (new 2026-10 AMD/stock suite + 9 regressions). 100% pass across the board. Spot-checked AMD guards in digitalocean-rdp-service.js and verified apidoc-page.js loads cleanly and documents GET /rdp/availability, in_stock/surcharge_usd/same_city_fallback on GET /rdp/plans, 409 out_of_stock on POST /rdp, and the 2026-10-14 changelog entry.

suite_results.apidoc_load: require('./apidoc-page.js') prints 'doc ok' with no errors

requirement_coverage_of_new_suite.1_amd_only_no_intel_or_basic_fallback: sections 2 (nyc3 Intel/Basic -> nyc1 AMD; Toronto Intel/Basic -> out_of_stock) and 6 (VPS never swaps CPU type)
requirement_coverage_of_new_suite.2_live_catalog_same_city_15pct_surcharge: sections 1 (catalog, 15-min refresh, Mongo persistence, last-good-copy on failure), 2 (same-city nyc1/nyc2 walk), 4 (+14.3% size used, +17.9% rejected, maxDoCost cap honoured by builder)
requirement_coverage_of_new_suite.3_rdp_pre_payment_gate_with_suggestions: section 3 (bot gate before payment screen, wallet re-check before debit, vpsOutOfStock + planOutOfStock suggestions)
requirement_coverage_of_new_suite.4_vps_same_size_same_city_only: section 6 (s-2vcpu-4gb walked nyc3->nyc1->nyc2 then out_of_stock, no CPU swap)
requirement_coverage_of_new_suite.6_reseller_async_lifecycle: section 5 (202 provisioning, provisioned only on active+IP, failure -> refund + provision_failed with reason_code out_of_stock|provision_failed|provisioning_timeout, atomic claim prevents double emit, host-scoped buildHost, exactly one provisioned event)
requirement_coverage_of_new_suite.7_admin_stock_alerts: section 8 (baseline, transitions only, two-pod race -> single alert via atomic hash swap, DO unreachable alert + recovery, start() wiring on refresh)

critical_code_review_comments: digitalocean-rdp-service.js line 171 defines BUILD_SIZE_FALLBACKS containing '-intel' and basic slugs. Verified via grep: it is only consumed at line 987 inside the golden-image builder (admin one-shot template prep) and never on the customer RDP creation path (createDroplet uses _attemptsFor -> _sizeOptions which are AMD-filtered via _isAmd). No customer droplet can land on Intel/Basic. Safe but worth a comment to prevent future misuse.
createDroplet properly walks only AMD attempts within quoted maxDoCost; createInstance throws err.code='out_of_stock' when _attemptsFor is empty (line 1217-1220).
do-size-catalog.js keeps the last good copy on refresh failure and marks refused sizes for 30 min — covered by section 2 and section 8 tests.
do-stock-watch.js atomic hash swap confirmed single-alert even with two pods (section 8).
reseller-api.js runVpsJob/checkAwaitingJob atomic findOneAndUpdate claim + buildHost scoping tested (section 5): a job owned by another host is left alone, no double refund possible.

apidoc-page.js GET /rdp/availability entry, in_stock/surcharge_usd/same_city_fallback on /rdp/plans, 409 out_of_stock on POST /rdp, and the 2026-10-14 changelog entry are all present and match actual API behaviour observed in the test suites.
seed_data_creation: none; every suite self-seeds and uses stubbed axios + isolated throwaway Mongo DBs. No real DigitalOcean calls, no reseller API endpoint on the preview URL was invoked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AMD-only RDP + same-city stock fallback + reseller async lifecycle are green on this tree. If re-running, keep suites serial because test_reseller_api_grace / reseller_vps_gone_reconcile / test_reseller_dup_guard share local Mongo collections. BUILD_SIZE_FALLBACKS at digitalocean-rdp-service.js:171 is golden-image-only; if someone later wires it into customer createDroplet, the AMD-only rule would break — add a regression guard assertion for that.
